author: Ariadne I
title: RC-DualDecay (k=96) + Curvature Reg + Stronger Factor Gate
abstract: Scales RC-DualDecay to k=96 and increases factor gating from 0.3→0.9 across the horizon to boost long-range accuracy. Trains with MAE + temporal curvature regularizer (L2 on second differences) and global-norm clipping. Retains residual copy head and column-normalized loadings.
